facts.text: ctrl-aviary-v0 is registered with entry point gym_pybullet_drones.envs:CtrlAviary and no keyword arguments
CtrlAviary defaults to drone model CF2X, one drone, physics PYB (PyBullet), pyb_freq 240 Hz, ctrl_freq 240 Hz, no GUI and no recording (CtrlAviary.py:12-26)
The CF2X drone's parameters come from its URDF: arm 0.0397 m, kf 3.16e-10, km 7.94e-12, thrust2weight 2.25, maximum speed 30 km/h, motor mass 0.027 kg
The thrust-to-weight constants give hover RPM sqrt(G*M/(4*KF)) and maximum RPM sqrt(thrust2weight*G*M/(4*KF))
The action space is a Box of shape (NUM_DRONES, 4): the commanded propeller speeds of each drone, bounded by 0 and MAX_RPM
The action is clipped to [0, MAX_RPM] before it is applied, so an out-of-range command is clamped by the environment itself

The observation space is a Box of shape (NUM_DRONES, 20): position, quaternion, roll-pitch-yaw, linear velocity, angular velocity and the clipped motor commands; z has a lower bound of 0, the quaternion components are bounded by +-1, the angles by +-pi and the motor commands by 0 and MAX_RPM
The observation of a drone is the horizontal stack of its position, quaternion, rpy, velocity, angular velocity and last clipped action
CtrlAviary's reward is the dummy value -1, its terminated flag is False, its truncated flag is False and its info is {'answer': 42}
ctrl-aviary-v0 is registered without max_episode_steps, so make() adds no TimeLimit and the environment never truncates
A reset re-creates the PyBullet simulation and zeroes the kinematic state: the drones start at their initial XYZ positions with identity attitude and no velocity
Without initial_xyzs every drone starts on the x axis at multiples of 4*arm, so the single drone of ctrl-aviary-v0 starts at the origin
The simulation timestep is 1/pyb_freq = 1/240 s and pyb_freq must be a multiple of ctrl_freq
The drone models are the enumerations CF2X, CF2P and RACE and the physics backends are PYB, DYN, PYB_GND, PYB_DRAG, PYB_DW and PYB_GND_DRAG_DW

determinism.notes: the reset places the drone at a fixed initial state, so the seed does not change the trajectory of this environment; the fake integrates a vertical model in Python floats while the upstream environment runs PyBullet, so the two do not agree on a trajectory

gaps: PyBullet rigid-body dynamics of the drone against the ground: the fake integrates only the vertical force balance (thrust from the mean motor speed against gravity) and leaves x, y, attitude and angular velocity at their reset values
the four rotor forces, ground effect, drag, downwash, collisions with obstacles and the URDF collision shapes are not modelled
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by the 1/240 s pybullet timestep only
no rendering, no video recording, no GUI debug sliders and no image capture (the vision attributes are off by default)
the fake backend re-implements the environment in pure Python and was not compared with the upstream PyBullet environment (gym_pybullet_drones was not importable where the gate ran)
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
